snippet.title: Survival-Horror Trailer - Psych Rift
snippet.description:
Psych Rift is a supernatural action-adventure game where armed with only a telekinetic glove and your wits, you must survive reality-bending nightmare worlds and their monsters to escape a research lab consumed by a dark entity from another dimension.

If you enjoyed this, you can wishlist Psych Rift now on Steam, and follow on the links below.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4093640/Psych_Rift/
Discord: https://discord.gg/dtNxAy74J5
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/ablazeinteractive.com
X: https://x.com/AblazeInt
